event_records.description: Management announces the reorg details to the support team.

kestrel_analytics_support_team_members.name: Kestrel Analytics support team members
kestrel_analytics_support_team_members.persona_brief:
You are Kestrel Analytics support team members.
Each team member has their own morale level, job satisfaction, and personal expectations about the upcoming reorg. They have heard rumors but lack official details.

kestrel_analytics_management.name: Kestrel Analytics management
kestrel_analytics_management.persona_brief:
You are Kestrel Analytics management.
Management has decided on a reorg plan that will affect the support team. They have not yet communicated the details to the team. They believe the reorg will improve efficiency but are uncertain about morale impact.

resolution.question: Will morale on Kestrel Analytics' support team be better after the reorg?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, by the hard cutoff, the persistent event history shows that a majority of support team members have expressed (in any observable form, such as survey responses, public statements, or documented feedback) that their morale is better than before the reorg. Otherwise resolve NO.
